user_reviews.Name: Scott Vanbeekom
user_reviews.Description:
Second time calling MVP for my plumbing needs and I am not disappointed.  This time was a tricky situation.  I got a hydrojet line stuck in my kitchen drain pipe (the nozzle got stuck).  Service tech Juan arrived as scheduled listened and looked at the situation I got myself into.  He assessed the problem and offered to get it unstuck manually.  No luck though.  He consulted with his supervisor but we didn't have too many options that wouldn't result in possibly damaging the pipe or equipment.  Unfortunately, the house does not have a crawl space so the pipes are inaccessible without major work so my problem still exist  because the fix would be a major job which I can't do right now.

What I am trying to say is that the service technician Juan was professional and gave his honest opinion.  He wasn't trying to force me into getting service done.  He gave me options.  Treat people with respect and you will get the respect back.

Give MVP a call it doesn't take much effort to have a conversation with the service tech.  This visit was free of charge.

user_reviews.Name: Isabella Roman
user_reviews.Description:
On the 13th of January I contacted the company to request a leak detection on my house, they sent an employee named Gabriel. After I showed him the area between the kitchen and the bathroom that the floor was hot- checking my water meter I knew I had an underground leak. Gabriel told me just for him to detect the leak it would be 875$ which I agreed and payed. Confirming we had a leak I asked the cost to fix, he quoted me 8-10,000$ to fix it. Shocked by the excessive amount I asked if that was the best price he could do the job for. He said he would talk to his office to see what he could do. He came back with a drastic price drop of 5300$ including the 875$ from him detecting the leak. I said I would have to get back to him. To make sure he marked the 2 areas of the broken pipe  correctly I hired another team and on Friday they began digging on the first area Gabriel had marked the leak to be. They dug 12 inches down and found no leak or pipe. I called Gabriel to tell him the situation. He said to send him pictures which I did and I offered for him to come and find the right spot instead of me spending more money which he never did. The new team who fixed the leak had to break even more concrete and cement 3-4 feet away from where he originally detected the leak which cost more money to fix. If we had dug in the second area he also incorrectly marked it would have cost even more. I left a message asking if he could call me back and called headquarters requesting assistance of a supervisor, 72 hours has passed and no one has reached out or made any attempt to apologize for the mistake. I would not recommend this company to anyone unless you want your money taken quick and want nonexistent assistance even quicker. I paid for professionals only to be professionally let down.
Sincerely,
an extremely upset customer

user_reviews.Description:
Peace of mind is exactly how I would describe our experience with Shellback Plumbing.

We recently moved to Santa Clarita and had no idea who to trust to re pipe our home. After checking Yelp, we narrowed it down to Shellback Plumbing and two other companies. We did our research and ultimately chose Shellback — and we’re so glad we did.

Edgar, who answers the phones, was helpful and responsive, and he scheduled Jesse to come out the very next day. Jesse was extremely knowledgeable about Kitec plumbing issues. Shellback Plumbing also offers the best warranty around and handled all the permits for the job, which gave us even more confidence in our decision.

Naturally, having a major job done on your home can feel overwhelming. But Jesse made us feel completely at ease. We trusted him so much that we left him with a key to our house — and that says a lot about both him and the company.

We hope we won’t have any issues in the future, but if we do, we feel confident knowing we’re covered by their warranty and will be taken care of.

We will absolutely be recommending Shellback Plumbing to everyone we know!

user_reviews.Name: Alex Lowry
user_reviews.Description:
I hired Shellback Plumbing to install a whole-house water filter, conditioner, and an automatic shutoff valve. While the technicians (Jesse and Raul) were incredibly friendly and the company is responsive, the experience was a mixed bag due to a lack of preparation and some expensive surprises.

The Pros:

- Professionalism: Jesse and Raul were very respectful and easy to talk to.

- Responsiveness: They are highly communicative and didn't hesitate to come back out to fix a post-installation leak.

- Aesthetics: The final install looks fairly clean, though a perfectionist might notice some slightly off angles and solder joints.

The Cons:

- Lack of Prep: I provided all spec sheets and installation guides well in advance. Despite this, it felt like they were "winging it" on a system they weren't familiar with. Installation took over 7 hours with multiple runs to get additional materials.

- Unplanned Costs: They failed to account for a bypass system in the initial quote, which resulted in a $700 surprise charge.

- Permit Oversight: No mention was made regarding city permits until I did my own research. That added another $450 to the project.

- Technical Error: They missed a critical "order of operations" step. They didn't advise me to flush the tanks after the initial 48-hour soak. I had to troubleshoot a bad taste/smell myself by calling the manufacturer to find out the flushing was required.

- 3 separate post installation visits to fix leaks

Summary: If you use Shellback, expect great people and good communication, but be prepared to do your own project management. You’ll need to double-check their technical requirements and local permit laws yourself to avoid unexpected costs.

- Aesthetics: The final install looks fairly clean, though a perfectionist might notice some slightly off angles and solder joints.

The Cons:

- Lack of Prep: I provided all spec sheets and installation guides well in advance. Despite this, it felt like they were "winging it" on a system they weren't familiar with. Installation took over 7 hours with multiple runs to get additional materials.

- Unplanned Costs: They failed to account for a bypass system in the initial quote, which resulted in a $700 surprise charge.

- Permit Oversight: No mention was made regarding city permits until I did my own research. That added another $450 to the project.

- Technical Error: They missed a critical "order of operations" step. They didn't advise me to flush the tanks after the initial 48-hour soak. I had to troubleshoot a bad taste/smell myself by calling the manufacturer to find out the flushing was required.

- 3 separate post installation visits to fix leaks

Summary: If you use Shellback, expect great people and good communication, but be prepared to do your own project management. You’ll need to double-check their technical requirements and local permit laws yourself to avoid unexpected costs.
user_reviews.reply_text_original: Hi Alex, we value your balanced feedback. While we're pleased Jesse and Raul provided good service, we're addressing the preparation issues and unexpected costs you experienced. Your insights help us improve.

user_reviews.Description:
Matthew is an honest and well-mannered individual. He arrived on time with all the necessary supplies to complete the job. The work turned out to be more involved than he initially anticipated, but even when I offered to pay the difference, he stuck to his original proposal.

Matthew took great care to protect our home, putting down floor coverings wherever he worked and thoroughly cleaning up afterward. He was especially careful when opening the drywall, only creating the openings necessary to complete the work properly, even when things got challenging.

Since he was working on a gas line, he took extra precautions, checking for leaks three to four times. He was patient, thorough, and focused on doing the job right instead of rushing through it.

Matthew also recommended a drywall professional to help close up the openings after the project, which was a huge help.

Overall, I am extremely pleased with Matthew Plumbing. I would absolutely recommend him to others. His charges are reasonable, and he is responsible and communicative -- more than I could ask for.

user_reviews.Name: Gina Lorenzo
user_reviews.Description:
This company was dispatched by First Home Warranty. The guy that came out to fix my garbage disposal seemed nice but apparently was completely incompetent and/or a liar! He told me that he wanted to check with the warranty company to see if they would cover a replacement & would get back to me. That same night I was washing dishes in the sink by hand and I realize there's water pouring out from under my sink!

I immediately stopped and called them. I tried they're emergency line but it still went to voicemail. I left a message and nothing! They never contacted me back after trying to reach them several times.

I finally go online to check the claim status & it's marked as closed - completed coverage denied. I contacted the Warranty company again & explained the situation. They told me the plumber claimed that there was a piece of metal in the sink & when I asked the plumber what he thought was wrong while he was here, he never said anything about metal in the disposal. I told First American I wanted a second opinion because this guy was incompetent. Then I start researching and I find all of these complaints, especially if they were sent out by a Home Warranty company.

Do NOT use these guys! Ask for someone else if your Warranty Co is sending them out. They're very unprofessional!

user_reviews.Name: Tom Gibson
user_reviews.Description:
I used John Murray because my condo Complex uses them and we have pretty bad pipes.  So I called them  for a leak from my shower upstairs.  The sent a very nice man over who showed up on time and was very professional.

After 2 hours he determined that the shower vaulve was leaking.  2 hours seems like a long time.  I did tell him that I had replaced the bath overflow  and thought I had messed that up.  It turns out I was wrong and the issue was the shower valve.     So I said ok go ahead and replace it.   He informed me that he couldn't, an estimator would have to send me an estimate and he would have to come back and that the charge for today was $320.  $320.   keep in mind that is for cutting a hole in the wall and finding a leak that was 6 inches behind the wall.

Then 3 days later I get an email asking for my email address so they can send me an invoice.  I ask how much is it I want to get this scheduled.  She explained she did not know and that the email would have the quote.  I said ok and that I would wait.

So the email comes.  $1010 was the quote in addition to the $320 charged to say the valve was leaking.  I have no idea if this is a good idea or not and I need it fixed so I called them to schedule.  They informed me that I needed to sign the estiamate first and send it back.  I said I did not have that facility.  they basically gave some options for downloading ot my phone and signing on my phone, but pretty much figure it out yourself.   I said this it too much work and that I would go with someone else.

Side note I am actually on the HOA board I have not done business directly with them before, but I was told good things by the management company.  Apparently they were not correct on their assessment of their customer service and pricing as searching on google show a reasonable price to be around $600 not $1330.  So I will be looking at these invoices more closely when they come from the management company and start asking for competing bids.

user_reviews.Name: Matt Bengtson
user_reviews.Description:
Unbelievably disrespectful customer service.

First I will say that they have a very good selection of parts.

Second I will say that the following does not apply to all the employees who work there (for instance the person who took my order-for a part they didn't have in stock- was helpful and polite)

I placed an order for a small atypical part with them because I like supporting small businesses. But along with that usually goes delightful customer service (like I experienced when I placed an order this most recent time)

After waiting a week I returned to the store and got in line to have the person in front of me called but then have someone else "jump" in line in front of me with this particular employee at the register.  I have jump in quotes because the employee initiated at the register initiated the process, (despite having been the only employee at the registers at the time when I joined the line which makes it hard for him to say he didn't know about the line).

I approached to question him about it. He told me he'd be with me in just a minute.... Thinking maybe he had something quick to help his buddy with, I waited. And waited.... as a large order of items was counted, questioned, conversed over, updated... The process continued for several minutes. Finally I confronted the two.  The employee silent, and the customer indignant that I called him out for having been shopping in the back of the store while others were waiting in line.

Shame on the employee and shame on the employer for tolerating this behavior.

Why should I pay more at a brick and mortar, only to have to wait longer for the part, drive farther (twice), and be intentionally neglected?

The obvious answer, I shouldn't.

So amazon it will be!

The less obvious question is how does management know that the employee didn't just blow a large order?

You couldn't pay me to come back.

The variety of other reviews indicate that at some of the employees don't give about the customers.

user_reviews.Name: JIM KLINE
user_reviews.Description:
I can’t say enough good things about All Star Plumbing and Rooter. Hire them

Need more?

One day my ‘regular’ plumber hydro-jetted my drain and had very bad news for me. He was seeing mud come out. I had a broken drain/sewer pipe under my slab. At my request my plumber jack-hammered a hole in my floor and got me ‘functional’ again. I had Franken-Pipe sticking out of my laminate, but water drained again. My plumber would have to cut a trench, potentially the length of the inside of my house, until he found the collapsed pipe to repair. He doesn’t do trenchless repair.

This is when I contacted All Star Plumbing and Rooter

Jose and Tony came out to my house with Ridgid Inspection Camera System. They went to my Franken-Pipe drain and started running their camera, explaining what they were looking at the entire time while I watched the screen. They found the collapsed section of pipe. It was only a few feet from where the hole in my floor was. This was great news for me. The closer the collapse the less of my floor gets torn up

As Tony was gathering up the gear and buttoning up the equipment they brought to properly inspect my situation, Jose let me know exactly what would need to be done to fix my problem. He explained the steps that would be taken to repair/replace my existing pipe that collapsed, how the rest of the run would be lined with a durable material to strengthen the internal structure of the remaining pipe, and how my plumbing would all be rebuilt and my slab would be good-as-new again. They did my repair in just over a day

Less than a week later the house failed me again

This time it was a Saturday morning. I had a clog in the Main Sewer Line. It had nothing to do with the other run All Star Plumbing and Rooter serviced for me a few days earlier. I get roots from neighbor trees from time to time, and the dang roots decided to cause me grief on a Saturday…and…my ‘regular’ plumber only works Monday through Friday. I called Jose at All Star Plumbing and Rooting and asked him if there was any chance he could have my clog cleared that weekend. He told me he had a crew that was finishing up another job and would have them stop by my house when they were done. In about 40 minutes my doorbell rang, and Tony was there with another couple of guys

Tony pulled the Ridgid from the back of the truck, showed my ‘sketchy spots’ in my pipe and my current problem, a root invasion

As Tony and his crew were bundling things up Jose pulled up at the front of my house…with his family in the car! Jose took some of his day off with his family to get my issue handled and make sure my house was OK. Jose also talked to me about my cast iron, 60 year old, Main Sewer Line. He let me know that Tony called him because Tony was concerned that the main Sewer Line was showing signs of deterioration and was worried I may experience something catastrophic in the near future…next month…next year…two years…sometime soon. It was then that I asked Jose to schedule me to have my Main Sewer Line trenchlessly replaced all the way to the city hook up, and to line the entire main sewer run for my house. A week later a small army of All Star Plumbing and Rooter experts showed up to do work

These guys don’t stop! Every one of the guys had a part of the job he was working on. My job required a hole in my concrete outside my front door, a hole in the sidewalk at the end of my driveway, and a hole in my back hard sidewalk because Tony found a cleanout with his camera that a prior owner had covered up with sidewalk concrete. Jose, Tony, everyone on the crew, and I all agreed it’s silly to leave that cleanout buried, and since they were doing concrete work anyway, why not unbury the cleanout and put a proper in-concrete cover over it with a new sidewalk section?

I can’t believe it only took the crew a couple of ways to do all of the work they did. When the job was done Jose got that Ridgid out of the truck again to show me my sewer pipes. Every inch was so clean!

These guys are fantastic, the work is second to none, and their pricing is very fair

user_reviews.Name: Lanna Dinero
user_reviews.Description:
DO NOT HIRE All Star Plumbing & Rooter

This company is an absolute nightmare. I brought them in to fix a simple leak, and they managed to turn it into a full-blown plumbing disaster. Not only was their work completely shoddy, but it also caused more damage than what I originally called them for.

Their so-called "technician" showed up late, reeking of cigarette smoke, and clearly had no clue what he was doing. He spent hours wandering around my house, messing with pipes he didn’t need to touch, and when he finally left, the leak was worse. A day later, my ceiling started leaking — from a bathroom they never even mentioned working on. When I called to complain, their office staff gave me the runaround and refused to send anyone back unless I paid again.

I ended up having to hire a real professional to undo their sloppy, borderline dangerous work. The second plumber was shocked at what he saw — loose fittings, cheap materials, and an entire section of pipe that had been installed backward. Yes, backward.

It’s beyond me how All Star Plumbing & Rooter is even in business. Sloppy work, zero accountability, and a customer service attitude that basically screams “not our problem.” Unless you enjoy flushing your money down the drain — pun absolutely intended — avoid this company like the plague.

Unfortunately, it was disappointing from start to finish.

I ended up having to hire another plumber who resolved the issue correctly in less than an hour.

Overall, unprofessional, unreliable, and overpriced. I would not recommend this company to anyone looking for honest or competent plumbing service.

user_reviews.Name: Maya Irigoyen
user_reviews.Description:
I noticed I had no hot water and found out there was an issue with my water heater. Luckily, this company was able to come out the same day to take a look.

They sent James, and I was actually relieved when I saw it was him because he had done other work at my house before (unrelated to this issue) and did an amazing job. Once again, he was great to work with. He was super knowledgeable, patient, and took the time to explain everything in a way that actually made sense. I never felt rushed or pressured, and he kept me informed every step of the way.

The biggest challenge ended up being my HOA, which can be very difficult to work with. They wanted me to wait until after the holiday weekend to approve the work, which would have left me without hot water for almost a week. James really went to bat for me and was able to get everything sorted out so the work could be done the very next day.

There were a few more complications with the HOA along the way, but James handled everything professionally and made a stressful situation so much easier. His communication was excellent, and his customer service was honestly above and beyond.

I'm extremely grateful for his help and would definitely recommend both James and this company. Having someone who is not only skilled at what they do but also genuinely cares about their customers makes all the difference.

user_reviews.Name: Troy Yudin
user_reviews.Description:
Here are two reasons why I only use Jacques Wylan Plumbing.

First, the toilet at our house wasn’t flushing consistently. We called a local plumbing company, and the first time they came out, they said nothing was wrong with it (of course it worked perfectly while they were there). The second time, they told us it would cost $1,600 to repair because of several issues they claimed were wrong. When we said we wanted a second opinion, they seemed bothered.

A friend connected us with Britini — thank goodness. Her team came out, assessed the situation, and told us it would actually be much more cost-effective to simply replace the toilet. Within an hour, we had a brand-new, perfectly working toilet installed for just a few hundred dollars.

Around the same time, one of the toilets at my business wasn’t working properly either. Before meeting Britini, I called another company. They gave me two options: rebuild a part and make additional repairs for $1,800, or try a temporary fix for $400. I chose the $400 option, and it worked… for two days. The problem came right back.

Before committing to the $1,800 repair, I asked Britini if her team could stop by the office. They fixed the issue with a $20 part — and it has worked ever since.

It’s rare to find someone you truly trust. That’s why I use Jacques Wylan Plumbing.

user_reviews.Name: James Masoner
user_reviews.Description:
These guys do the job right and they get it done fast!

We recently opened a brick and motor business in Valencia. Shortly after opening, we discovered that our general contractor had done a poor job installing the commercial sink and drain pipes in our dishwashing area. There were leaks causing problems for us and the neighboring unit.

We reached out to Ace Drain, hoping we could get on their schedule within 1 to 2 days like most plumbers. Valerie was extremely helpful and provided great customer service over the phone. She recognized the urgency of our problem and notified Shane of our situation. He finished up the job they were on, then rushed over to our shop within hours. Then they quickly assessed the issue, provided a quote, and fixed everything before the end of day. We were amazed and relieved!
Shane and his team understand how important it is for a business to be able to keep their doors open and keep customers coming through. Needless to say, they are our go-to plumber for our business or home.
Bookmark this page and save their number in your contact list because these are the only plumbers you'll ever need!

user_reviews.Name: David Hasenauer
user_reviews.Description: A DIY "minor" shower project turned into a plumbing emergency to get water turned back on for our house.  Found Rooter Man plumbing on-line, read reviews, and contacted them.  They were GREAT!!!.  Plumber Jonathon M. arrived about 90' after I called (with great communication from Rooter Man on when and who would arrive). While my 40-year-old shower valve was not fully repairable, Jonathan was able to fix it well enough to turn on the main water supply.  I was quoted a reasonable price to install new piping (including separate shower cut-off valves) and controls. Jonathon was back the next day to finish the job. He spent about 4.5-hours, including cutting tile.  The original arrival time quoted was 9 am, but about 9:10 they called to let me know he would be delayed until 9:30 to 9:45 (he had trouble getting the replacement parts) and he arrived within that new window.  Once again, superior customer communication.  My wife and I were completely satisfied with the workmanship of the repair except that I found a short time later that the new shower temperature control handle was a bit too loose.  I called Rooter Man about 45' after Jonathan had left to let them know  I received a quick call back, and Jonathon returned early evening the same day to fix this (issue was with the replacement part bolt length and an optional plastic insert).  The bolt was modified, the plastic insert removed and the handle is now tight.  I cannot recommend them more highly, and plan to call them for future plumbing needs (asking for Jonathan M. if available).  We are 100% satisfied.

user_reviews.Name: Beverly Lewis
user_reviews.Description:
Five-Star Review for Jack’s Services

I first found Jack when I needed someone to board up my aunt’s windows after they were broken during the Sylmar fire. The first company I called tried to overcharge me—asking more than it would have cost to replace the windows entirely. It was a clear case of price gouging. When I spoke with Jack, he gave me a fair and reasonable quote for the work and promised to meet me at the house within an hour after picking up the necessary supplies. True to his word, he arrived on time, was both personable and professional, and I immediately noticed how well-organized and clean his truck was—a small but telling sign of a business that operates with care and efficiency. He secured the property quickly and did an excellent job.

I was so impressed with Jack’s work that I hired him a second time to install fencing around my yard to stop a rabbit infestation that was destroying my landscape. Desperate for help, I reached out on Super Bowl Sunday, not expecting much, but Jack once again came to the rescue. He arrived, took precise measurements, and gave me a very reasonable quote. His work was meticulous, and he even adjusted the final price after returning extra materials—an uncommon display of honesty and integrity.

Jack is a consummate professional who delivers quality work at fair prices. I wouldn’t hesitate to hire him again and will absolutely be recommending him to friends and family.

user_reviews.Description:
Terrible Experience – Unprofessional and Overpriced

I had a very disappointing experience with Kurt Bohmer Plumbing Inc. Our appointment was scheduled for 10:00 AM, but they didn’t show up until 1:20 PM. The technician who was supposed to be familiar with septic systems was stuck on another job, so they sent someone else who clearly had no knowledge of septic tanks. I only found this out when I called to complain—and the employee admitted it.

We called them because we had a clog, but no one told us the septic tank might be full until they ran a jetter into the line leading directly into our house. The only explanation given to my husband was, “We couldn’t get the clog and we have to go.” That’s it. No resolution, and we were still charged $450.

Mike.

user_reviews.Name: Brian Stucka
user_reviews.Description:
Typical dirty beat up plumbing warehouse set up with a counter mainly focused on serving their loyal group of local Pro plumbers .  As a capable DIY guy, I'll sometimes choose a place like this to pick up specialty items I would not be likely to find in a big box store.  Their expertise is a plus, their attitude rarely is.  In this case, I needed a new cartridge for a leaky Delta shower head.  They are sold on ebay and Amazon for around $35.00 but I wanted the convenience of fixing my problem the same day and thought I'd be less likely to wind up with the wrong part.  They found the part right away and the kid processed me quickly.  The owner peeked out of his office and I checked with him about whether it would be a good idea to grease the seals lightly during installation.  He indicated that a small amount of vaseline was a good idea...  I paid around $70.00.  Full retail markup for the convenience and advice.

After getting home, I opened the bag it was sold in and noticed that this was obviously a part that had been returned in the past.  The bag was beat up and the top had been restapled.  No biggie, I thought, someone probably bought the wrong part and returned it.  I spent a little bit of time inspecting it and noticed one seal ring had a slit in it that went about 90% of the way through the seal.  Ah ha!  Now I know why it was previously returned.  I choose to give them the benefit of the doubt because the cut was hard to see and drive all the way back for an exchange.

The way I was treated on my second visit, you'd have thought I stole candy from their child.  I pointed out the slit to a different guy at the counter and he called the owner out of his office.  This guy comes out yelling "I thought I told you to grease the seals before installing it!"  He was trying to flip blame on me for his bad part.  I found myself on the defensive pointing out that I hadn't even tried to install it yet... "look, it isn't wet or scratched and the seal cut isn't what would normally happen from a dry jam install attempt anyway."  And what about the obvious fact that this part had been returned before?  He dismissed me, grabbed another part and demanded that I inspect it in front of him before leaving "because you ain't getting another one if this one is bad..."  I should have told him to shove it and give me a refund but the part looked fine and I didn't want to drive another 30 miles to the next warehouse so I agreed to his terms and finished the job.  To be fair, the cartridge does not leak.

Places like this are not DIY friendly, they act like selling to us (at grossly inflated prices) is taking food out of the mouths of the kids of their loyal pro customer base.  One of his pro plumbers would have charged me $700.00 to fix my shower.  I fixed it for $70.00 and an argument.  I am still annoyed enough the next day to take the time to write this post.

user_reviews.Name: Gwen Majors
user_reviews.Description: Do not use this company. They installed a new cental air unit.   I paid 9 grand. I relied on the info, trusted and believed the info I received.  They are legally required to pull a city permit so the  city can inspect their work after completion.  This was extremely important to me and I was assured it would be done and it is legally required, and it was quoted in my estimate. After the installation,   I discovered they did not pull the city permit.  They said it was an "error".  UPDATE:  It is now 3 months later and I still cannot get the city inspection completed because Fleetwell will not cooperate.  They say they will make the appointment but do not.  Now I've discovered I am not getting heat. I've requested an appt for a tech.  Still no appt. So they won't honor their 2 year warranty either.  There is no manager to speak to.  When I call it goes to a receptionist who has no information on my account and can only have someone call me back.The email address has no name associated.  It just says 'office'.   This business is super shady.   I am now at the point of filing a lawsuit for breach of contract and code violations.  I am not an easy person to fool, but they got me.  They have an amazing sales person named Scott Hardy.  He said all the right things.  So out of the 4 companies I consulted with, I went with Fleetwell. I made a huge mistake.

user_reviews.Description:
I recently installed a new vanity and sink in our guest bathroom. I hired a handyman from TaskRabbit who specialized in plumbing to install the faucet, mainly because our HVAC unit drains into the sink’s p-trap, and the existing drain pipe was a different size and very short. Unfortunately, I didn’t realize until weeks later that he had jimmy-rigged the attachment which created a slow leak. I only discovered it when I opened the vanity cabinet and found water pooling inside.

That’s when I found Josh from Layout Plumbing on the Nextdoor app and I’m so glad I did. He had glowing reviews, and now I understand why.

I contacted Josh on a Sunday morning, and he responded right away. He asked several questions, requested photos, and was able to diagnose the issue. He sent over a quote and showed up first thing Monday morning.

Not only did he fix the leak properly, but he also noticed that the faucet handles had been installed incorrectly and he fixed that too, at no additional charge.

Josh was prompt, professional, knowledgeable, and thorough. I highly recommend Layout Plumbing and will absolutely call Josh again for any future plumbing needs!

user_reviews.Name: Melanie Galuten
user_reviews.Description:
AMAZING.  I know, seems odd to say the words 'amazing' in the post world of the Palisade Fire.  BUT our experience was fantastic.  We recently had American Craftsman Restoration handle the dwelling cleaning after the Palisades Fire, and we couldn’t be more impressed. The team was responsive, thorough, and professional throughout the process.

A special thanks to Brian, who went above and beyond, negotiating with our insurance company with integrity — never “bilking” the insurer, just ensuring the work was done right and fairly.

The post-toxin testing showed excellent results, which is especially remarkable given that our property was immediately next to burn sites. Many neighbors with homes much farther from the fire still showed residual toxins even after cleaning, but our home was thoroughly restored.

We highly recommend American Craftsman Restoration to anyone in need of post-fire cleaning — honest, meticulous, and effective work from start to finish.

Many interactions with management felt dismissive, as if residents were a bother rather than customers. While a few staff members tried to help, leadership and parts of the management team were very unprofessional.

One staff member, Patrick, was consistently rude, passive-aggressive, and unwilling to help, to the point where I tried to avoid interacting with him. How this person has a customer facing job is baffling to me. I think he even got internally promoted, which is WILD, and such a good representation of management disconnect.

If you decide to pursue, I've had good experiences with Talia and Chelsea. There has been quite a turnover on staff as well from what I saw, I haven't interacted with the new people in, but they seem great ~ Again, this is mostly an upper management / leadership issue.

Regardless, there were also issues with frequent staff entries into the unit, including one situation where staff entered while my son was inside, undressed. Another time, despite us asking for notice, they came in when we requested us to be present, as to not startle our elderly cat with a heart condition. We just asked them to come in any other time, where we could be there to reassure her. They, of course, didn't care and came in anyways. We simply didn't feel at home.

Finally, after leaving the apartment clean and in good condition, more than $500 was deducted from our $1,000 deposit for repainting and other charges. Landlords cannot legally deduct for "normal wear and tear"—the expected, gradual deterioration from daily, reasonable use—from a security deposit. We left the building exactly how it was given to us. I don't even know what to add to that. First time in my life I'm not getting my full deposit back, but not surprising, given their record. That was the last straw, got me to write this review, hopeful that no one else has a bad experience. Definitely feel crooked here.

Overall, a very disappointing experience, and I'm glad it's over.

Silver lining, the technicians ( Especially Carlos ) have been tremendously amazing and professional, all the way to the end. They carried the experience for us, and even though we had multiple technical issues throughout our stay ( Which is fine, those things happen over a year of stay ), they helped us big time.

I trust IMT with a great PR or passive aggressive response to come clean of everything I pointed up there. Doesn't change my experience, which turned from bad to extremely worst on those last days.

Linked images of my move out, good thing I took multiple videos and such, bad thing is that Google review can't take them in, but happy to share them with anyone if asked for ~

TLDR : 5 stars for Maintenance Staff, ( Read the 5 stars review, they are carrying the whole thing ), 1 star for everything else.

I’ve lived at this apartment complex for over a year now, and honestly, it’s been a really frustrating experience. From the day I moved in, the unit wasn’t in good shape, there was no heat, the dishwasher didn’t work, and the washing machine was broken for months.

One of the biggest ongoing issues has been the upstairs neighbor. They keep what looks like a nursery on their patio, and whenever they clean it, all the dirty water, dirt, and grime drains down onto our patio. It’s damaged some of our personal belongings, which is incredibly upsetting.
I’ve reported this to management at least five different times, all documented, and nothing has changed. Every time I reach out, I get the same generic response with ChatGPT. No real follow up, no call, no actual effort to fix the situation.
On top of that, the water gets shut off way too often, sometimes it feels like every week. For what they’re charging, this place just isn’t worth it. I wouldn’t recommend moving here based on my experience.

user_reviews.Name: Amanda Wood
user_reviews.Description: Do yourself a favor and run from this apartment complex. I was there for less than a year and I had three floods, two of them in the kitchen which ruined a bunch of my supplies, one of them in the bathroom, less than one month there was a fire in my building because the maintenance cart which is parked under my building started to smoke or it on fire and we had to evacuate. Multiple times the water had been shut off for some other purpose with very little warning, I’m talking an email with 30 minute heads up. The final straw which made me vacate in under a year of living here was that there was a gas leak in my building which caused me to feel extremely dizzy and I had to make a trip to the ER, keep in mind they had just done yearly services to check the fire, alarms and carbon monoxide leaks, and no alarm went off in my apartment, thankfully, I wasn’t asleep because this could’ve been deadly, and after complaining to the apartment complex they said were not at fault and these were common issues in apartments. Fun fact every time maintenance had to come and fix something in my building they told me that this would keep happening because the building refused to update all of their issues. And a cherry on top is when I went to pay my final move out bill they somehow double charged me on my credit card and then I had to wait six weeks for a dispute. Also don’t be surprised if your security deposit apparently doesn’t cover enough because they neglect to tell you that there’s a mandatory $250 cleaning fee for the apartment and they decided to repaint my apartment out of my security deposit when I was told that it was repainted prior to me moving in. Also, apparently they don’t care about privacy because when they called to tell me that my security deposit wasn’t enough while I was working, instead instead of waiting for me to call back or sending an email, they decided to call my mother and explain financial situations to her. Since when is it OK to explain other people’s finances to somebody else regardless of them being family or not with no permission to do so? The only semi redeeming quality was how quickly their maintenance responded to emergency request, and they were very real for telling me these issues would keep happening. Just don’t move here.

user_reviews.Name: Sarah Clevinger
user_reviews.Description:
Power went out when our 16 year old was home alone babysitting toddlers, in a panic we called to have an electrician come out and see what happened, and met him here. Once he was already at our house he says theres a diagnostic and a service fee, which we said okay, but he did not say what that fee was. Also did not disclose the fee ahead of time on the phone.
Then he said there was no power coming from the city. And then made a comment about high winds and power being shut off out of caution (we didn't get any notifications from Edison that this would happen, and on the website it did not say our area was having an outage)* update here, it was a blown transformer fuse, and still absolutely ridiculous not to disclose prices on the phone, BEFORE arrival.

He spent a total of maybe 10 minutes here and said he lived 11 minutes away.... but the proceeded to charge us $300 for the visit... once he was already here, this was not disclosed on the phone, or before he proceeded to "diagnose" the lack of power at the breaker with his meter. And what do you even do in that situation? Say no??
We could have just gone to a hotel for the night for that price. Just absolutely floored since all of the reviews said the opposite.

user_reviews.reply_text_original: Good evening.  We wanted to respond to your review. So, every contractor charges different prices. The only requirement is to tell your client up front what you charge. And we did that. We have a flat rate for our service call and troubleshooting. Whether we are there for one minute or 6 hours it is always the same. Our tech before he began asked you specifically if you were okay with the fee. You said that you were. So he proceeded. We were already eleven minutes around the corner doing a troubleshooting so we came out after we finished our call on crown valley road. We wanted to make sure that we were being fair so we contacted another electrician today and he said that he would have charged twice that amount because it was an emergency after hours call. In which he said the price doubles. So, we know we have done nothing wrong. I know that you may not understand why the price it’s what it is but there are many factors that go into it. Gas, techs salary, advertising, insurance,Google charges us a fee so we hope that you understand. We really appreciate you and your business and are sorry that you were not happy but I think that Edison is the company that you should be upset with. Many other areas including the one we were working in on Crown Valley had electricity. So he would not know that Edison had your power off. So honestly we are not sure why you are upset with us. But hope things get better. Best wishes. SB

After such a stressful experience, their kindness and expertise gave me real peace of mind. I’m so grateful for their help and would highly recommend Paul Davis to anyone dealing with the aftermath of a fire or any other home disaster.

user_reviews.Name: Janice Reinschreiber
user_reviews.Description:
My son’s bathroom was in desperate need of remodeling. We had three contractors give us estimates. Jacob Beckert, the owner of All Exclusive Construction Inc., immediately stood out as remarkable and impressive. He is young, but talk to him for a few minutes and you realize he is competent, experienced, and relatable, which makes his youth an asset—you soon understand that you are dealing with a precocious talent.

During the consultation, Jacob was an excellent listener and educator and seemed genuinely interested in our preferences. He went out of his way to find out what we wanted but also made professional recommendations when we got stuck. He took notes by pen and paper, was never pushy or overbearing, and promptly sent a detailed schematic and estimate. The price was reasonable.

We had mentioned that there were a few other things throughout the house we might want fixed; for instance, all three toilets were old and barely functioning. Since we only said this in passing, we were pleasantly surprised to find that this had already made its way into the estimate and was included in the proposal. With such attention to detail, we knew that Jacob was the right contractor for the job.

The work crew was equally professional, capable, and courteous. Jacob runs a tight ship, frequently checking in; there were never more than three workdays that he didn’t show up to monitor the job’s progress. Communication was frequent and thorough. We couldn’t believe how hard they worked. They even worked Saturdays (with our permission). At the end of the day, they would spend up to an extra hour just cleaning—even more than we would have ourselves.

As an example of the crew’s ingenuity, after they started laying the floor in the shower, my son decided he didn’t like the tile he had chosen. Unfortunately, the new design he wanted conflicted with the slope of the cement work that had already been completed. This created a significant challenge for the team to try and come up with a work-around at the last minute. We never thought for a second that they wouldn’t figure something out—and they did! The new design is so beautiful, you could never tell it was a creative solution to a problem.

It’s not an easy process; a project like this is tedious and the disruption to regular life is substantial. There were setbacks along the way. But it was worth it in the end. Thank you to Jacob, Pedro, and the rest of the team at All Exclusive Construction. My son loves his new bathroom! We will definitely have you back.

user_reviews.Name: Garrett Newman
user_reviews.Description:
Got matched up with DeDona by our insurance company after a pretty extensive loss due to water back in January. We had a bit of a strange claim experience - due mostly to the fact that our claim was started right as the Palisades fires had begun.

This led to an understandably slow process on the insurance end, and I am sure a hectic process for our local contractors who they use. Despite this, DeDona took great care of us, were super communicative with us and our insurance and made sure the early stages of our claim was handled well.

Super grateful for their team, especially Brian for keeping me in the loop at every turn, Gina for handling all of our personal property for us, and Mike, the owner, for getting involved whenever he was needed.

Seven months later, we are finally back home and even now months after their work at our home was done they've checked in to see how things are going and are helping us get back settled in. Great family run company, would definitely recommend!

user_reviews.Name: matthew cabral
user_reviews.Description:
We recently had a sewage backup at our rental property in Palm Springs, from a guest flushing wipes down our toilet. It created water damage in half of the house and due to the unsanitary nature of the back up, we had an emergency on our hands. Our property manager connected us with DeDona Restoration and their owner Michael to handle the mitigation and rehab.

From the start we felt very comfortable with the plan of action and the steps needed in order to get our house back up and ready to rent again. Being that we’ve never had to deal with this, Michael was very thorough in his explanations (and expectations) and also walked us through the process of handling the insurance claims. This was especially important to us, as everything was detailed and submitted in the manner in which was required by the insurance. He was there every step of the way and if anything went sideways during the process, he was there to assure us that it would be taken care of, which relieved a lot of stress from our side.

Overall, it was a great experience and we were able to complete the restoration on time and the house looks like nothing had ever happened to it. We are truly grateful for the excellent service and communication with Michael and DeDona Restoration!

user_reviews.Name: Bishan Seneviratne
user_reviews.Description:
We recently experienced a devastating main water supply line break at our school, flooding all classrooms, offices, and the lobby. Amidst the chaos, DeDona Restoration was recommended to us by a local plumbing company, and it was the best decision we made.

Meeting Mr. Michael Fitzgibbons and his team, including Brian and Gina, was an absolute pleasure. They were empathetic, understanding, and quickly devised a restoration plan that minimized disruptions to our daily operations.

Recognizing the urgency of our situation, DeDona worked tirelessly during after-hours to accommodate our needs. Their attention to detail is impeccable, and their professionalism is unparalleled.

In my 28 years of experience, I have dealt with similar situations, but none have been resolved as seamlessly as this one. DeDona's execution was flawless, completing the restoration of eight classrooms, two staff rooms, the director's office, and the lobby in just over six weeks.

Michael and Brian kept me informed every step of the way, providing regular updates and even using FaceTime to show me the progress. The restoration was done safely and cleanly, leaving me confident and comfortable with the outcome.

I highly recommend DeDona Restoration Company to anyone in need of restoration services, regardless of the job's size or complexity. Their exceptional service, attention to detail, and commitment to customer satisfaction make them the top choice in the industry.

user_reviews.reply_text_original:
Adam,

While I understand your frustration here, it is imperative that we check the PSI upon all installations. High pressure exceeding 80 PSI is an indicator that your regulator has failed and it puts all your water points of distribution at risk. Your water heater, angle stops, dishwasher, washing machine and even the unions and elbows in your walls are all at risk when the pressure is too high.  Risk that can result in thousands of dollars in damage to your home. With the water treatment system the first point of distribution post regulator, we feel obligated to both you and Rayne to inform you of this risk and that Rayne is not responsible for damage caused due to high water pressure in your home. Obviously, you have the option to install a regulator on your own, hire a plumber or Rayne can help with that too. Some choose to do nothing; this is also completely your prerogative. However, we strongly feel it is our responsibility to inform you of this prior to any damage taking place whenever possible.  Thank you.

user_reviews.Name: Nana S
user_reviews.Description:
One of the best apartments I had the pleasure staying. I was in a transition state (divorce) and needed a calm, and clean place to get my emotional and physical life back together. From the begging to the end, I experienced care, professionalism, and amazing customer support. I can't say enough high praises for Tamer, Claudia, followed by maintenance crew and cleaning crew.
Tamer is the best - he is friendly, knowledgeable, kind, and most importantly always there for you. He knows all the guests by name and is there to meet your needs nonstop. He even tolerated the complaints I got from neighbors when I brought in a new dog (she was having anxiety issues and was barking nonstop when left alone). He guided me into training her and informed me that I needed to figure out a solution so all neighbors would benefit. Which I totally agreed and spent a full 2 days training her (watched lot of YouTube videos). Without Tamers guidance she would still be living with anxiety.
Claudia is a sweetheart, always kind, supportive and full of smiles. I probably locked myself out 5 times and she never judged or made it seem like my mistakes were affecting her. Also, she gave me the best tips about Santa Clarita, and things I could do to enjoy and explore this town.
Sebastian was amazing as well - I accidentally left my car running and needed a jumper. He came to the rescue. As you can tell I had several issues while living here (caused by me) that Bell customer support had to handle and by far the best support I have received.

As for the apartment - No issues, clean, well maintained, and if I had any issues the crew fixed it right away. Totally recommend living here.

Best memories - made friends while we enjoyed the pool, had my birthday party in the lounge room, and was able to reduce my anxiety level because living here I never once experienced any hardship.

user_reviews.Name: Josue Rivera
user_reviews.Description:
I would like to preface this review with  this: We absolutely love this location and our home. We have been living here for 5 years now and love the leasing office staff (Claudia and Tammer) and maintenance team (Domingo, Cesar, and Carla). I remain true to what I shared about this property prior to this review: "Very personable and I’m glad they stayed after the transition from Monetecito to Bell Valencia. I can always go to the office and feel cared for.  We have had some major maintenance things happen due to normal wear and tear, but the maintenance team is great as well! We are sticking around as long as we can."

HOWEVER, most recently we had what seemed to be a sewage back up that affected 3 apartment units on the 1st floor. According to vendors who came the day of the incident (October 27th, 2024) we were the worst of the 3. We are so glad our dog was not home that morning, because she would have been terrified or her life could have been on the line being exposed to black water bacteria. The vendors had  air scrubbers and dehumidifiers going the next 3 days. At that time, we were not able to stay there due to the conditions of the apartment and the work needed to be done. The wall was finally opened and treated for mold and other pathogens on November 5th. The repair of the drywall was completed on November 7th and the floor on November 8th. However, the floor was a different color! Domingo was able to arrange the floor with the vendor and got it done by November 9th. Unfortunately, the repairs that were done weren't done very carefully as there was chipping on the baseboards and trim that they reinstalled as well as damaging one of our door frames when they were ripping the wall out. This was a holiday weekend and unfortunately the leasing office was closed and wouldn't be able to arrange a clean up until the following week which would have been the start of week 3 OF NOT BEING ABLE TO LIVE IN OUR APARTMENT. Because of this, we decided to take the cleaning upon ourselves. I have asthma and everything was so dusty and I couldn't move back in without dusting/cleaning all the surfaces and even purchasing an air purifier. At the time of the incident and realizing that we were going to be out of our home, I asked about getting a discount on rent for that incident. We were told that the COMPANY asked that we would address this until all the work was done in the apartment. After moving back into our home, I reached out to the leasing office to reach out to the COMPANY to let them know that we were not able to live in our home for 2 weeks total and we were being charged normal rent at the time, which was so wrong in the first place. I eventually received an answer in December which was a NO. However the leasing office mentioned that the regional oversight was going to go back to their oversight in hopes to get a different answer. I reached out to corporate ( Bell Partners Inc) on the last week of December as a last resort and letting them know that I was going to be doing this review. Today is January 3rd 2025, and I have yet to hear back from them.

We have lived here for 5 years and this was the absolute worst event that has happened that left us out of our apartment without a home for almost 3 weeks! The company showed no care for us by not relocating us, offering a new unit, a discount on rent and reimbursement on purchases for cleaning, or communicating with me after reaching out to them. As much as I would recommend this place due to the location, the community, and staff; I would not recommend or bet that the Management Company Bell Partners Inc has the best interest or care for its tenants.

Attached are pictures of what we came home to on October 27th and some work that vendors completed as well as the mess that was left.

user_reviews.Name: Maya Barry
user_reviews.Description: A technician from WTP Construction Santa Clarita visited my home to provide an estimate for the removal of a huge Live Oak stump that had destroyed my patio. My patio was in ruins with sections raised at a 45-degree angle due to the stump. The stump needed to be excavated and the hole filled and compacted to prepare for the patio rebuild. They told me they were quite busy with other projects, so the job would be scheduled a few weeks ahead. They called me ahead of time to arrange a day and time. The technician and his worker arrived punctually, discussed what needed to be done, and got right to work. The job was far from simple as the stump was near water lines, and my septic leach field was directly behind the work area. Despite this, their skill with their equipment was impressive. They managed to remove the stump with ease, even with the size of the excavator compared to the stump. They accomplished all of this without any damage to my waterlines or leach field, showing their expertise and care. In addition to removing the stump, they filled and compacted the hole, removed the old patio concrete, brought in new base rock and spread it, and handled other heavy-lifting jobs made easier with their heavy equipment on site. They relocated the large oak rounds from the tree to a central pile, removed and graded multiple rock-walled gardens, and relocated several burn piles in the area and graded the sites since they are no longer in use. They also cut some concrete away from the house to make a clean edge for the new patio. The two-person crew was punctual, professional, and highly skilled. Their work was flawless, and the cost was incredibly reasonable. I had received estimates from other companies that were more than three times the estimate given by this company, and those higher estimates were for less work than what was performed. This shows that their prices are fair, and their work is honest. They were willing to do extra work on site and make recommendations based on my future rebuild plans, and were very flexible. My wife was extremely happy with the final product in terms of function, aesthetics, and safety. We're now ready for the rebuild! If you have any heavy equipment work that needs to be done, including earth moving, road building, or septic, I highly recommend you give them a call. Many thanks to the wonderful crew for a job well done!

I highly recommend United and Deagan for their honesty, integrity and customer service.

user_reviews.Name: Dan Holland
user_reviews.Description:
I can't say enough good things about Luxury Bath and the incredible experience I had working with them. From start to finish, the process was handled with care, professionalism, and a true sense of urgency.
Owner John went above and beyond to make sure our new walk-in shower was installed before my wife returned home from the hospital after suffering a stroke. He personally made it a priority, pushing to have all the custom parts made and delivered within just two weeks.
The installation crew was outstanding. They removed our old fiberglass tub and installed the new walk-in shower in just one day. The result is nothing short of amazing. The shower is not only beautiful, and modern, but also thoughtfully designed with safety and accessibility in mind. It includes non-slip flooring, a fold-down seat, three strategically placed grab bars, and two shower heads—one handheld for convenience.
Thanks to John's commitment and the skilled team at Luxury Bath, my wife now has a safe and comfortable space to bathe independently. It’s a huge relief and a big step toward restoring some normalcy to our lives.
I highly recommend Luxury Bath to anyone looking for quality craftsmanship, responsive service, and a company that truly cares

user_reviews.Name: Jennifer Sykes
user_reviews.Description:
After calling multiple different restoration companies in Santa Clarita that resulted in continual ringing with nobody ever picking up, I finally got someone to pick up the phone when calling ServPro! John was attentive and courteous as I explained my situation. He gave me a ballpark quote and after booking an appointment for an in-person consultation, he gave me his personal line in case I needed to reach him for any reason.
Billy (William) and Roly (Rolando) arrived the following day for the consultation. They were so sweet and personable. Once looking at the area to be restored, they told me that they believed that it would actually probably be closer to the lower end of the original quote as it was such a small area. It was so refreshing to hear something to go in the consumer’s favor for once as I’m so used to being overcharged and taken advantage of.  Billy and Roly were trying to make my future service as easy for me as possible, going over options of same day service if starting in the morning, but after hearing I’d like to avoid calling out of work, explained that I can book two consecutive days after my work shifts as to not disrupt my life too much. They were incredibly kind!
So far so good!!
Fingers crossed for a great service that matched their professionalism so far! I will update after completion.

I strongly advise against hiring PMP to manage any property. Their mismanagement has significantly deteriorated the quality of life in our building, and their lack of accountability is alarming.
•	Neglect and Unresponsiveness: There is no way to reach PMP after hours, and during business hours, residents are left waiting on hold with no callbacks. Basic management responsibilities are consistently ignored.
•	On-Site Manager Issues: The on-site manager is unprofessional, unresponsive, and hostile toward both residents and vendors. They have even leaked oil onto the property, leaving residents to deal with the mess and costs.
•	Security Failures: PMP has neglected major entry doors, leading to repeated break-ins and property damage. Instead of addressing these security concerns, they tolerate inappropriate behavior from staff, with no policies in place to prevent misconduct.
•	Board Misconduct and Election Delays: PMP aligns with the board in violating bylaws, including delaying elections from November to April, risking the association’s charter status.
•	Financial Mismanagement: PMP has overseen the misallocation of funds, including multiple unnecessary and redundant paint jobs—some units painted up to four times. They ignored expert engineering advice regarding federally regulated balcony repairs. Meanwhile, dues have increased, earthquake insurance has been lost, and yet the property continues to decline.
•	Retaliation Against Homeowners: Rather than addressing concerns, PMP and the board use legal intimidation tactics to silence residents. I was personally threatened with legal action simply for sending emails—something that should be unnecessary if the on-site manager were performing their job correctly.

PMP’s mismanagement, lack of professionalism, and disregard for residents’ well-being make them a disastrous choice for property management. If you are considering hiring them, be aware—you will be played. I encourage anyone questioning my claims to visit the property for a firsthand look.

My concerns are currently under legislative review. If you are dealing with similar issues, stay informed and be aware of the board, management, and attorneys who use bullying tactics against homeowners.

We needed a very large, heavy bathroom vanity lowered after moving in, and Tyler responded right away to our inquiry. It's always scary hiring a contractor, but I feel so lucky to have found Tyler. He's a gem. I'll definitely call him again if I have any issues.

user_reviews.Name: 2 Llamas ENT
user_reviews.Description:
I live in a home that was built in the 1950s, and although I’m not exactly sure when the electrical panel was last replaced, likely in the 70s or 80s, I knew it needed to be upgraded for today’s safety standards and technology. I did my research on Google and in local Santa Clarita Facebook groups, and all signs pointed to David Electric.

When I called, I learned that David has an incredible team and is highly recommended throughout the Santa Clarita Valley. I spoke with several other companies as well, but David Electric provided a clear and reasonable quote right away. David explained exactly what needed to be done and made me feel confident in moving forward.

When the team,  Jeremy arrived for the initial visit, Jeremy explained the need for a “spot check” to ensure the panel location complied with updated code requirements. Although David and Jeremy expected it to be a quick request with Southern California Edison (SCE), we found out that SCE had changed their process and now required everything through an online portal. After multiple attempts on my end, I was getting nowhere.

David stepped in and went above and beyond the call of duty to resolve the issue. Thanks to his persistence, SCE finally came out, completed the inspection, and confirmed that the panel location was acceptable. From there, we scheduled the upgrade to a new, safe, up-to-code breaker panel.

Jeremy and Jorge (I liked to call them Double J) arrived right on time at 8:30 a.m., professional, prepared, and ready to work. They were kind, respectful, extremely knowledgeable, and focused throughout the entire process. Even when Jeremy briefly needed to return to the shop for a part, Jorge continued working seamlessly. I had a million questions, and they patiently answered every single one with expert knowledge and zero hesitation. That level of professionalism and customer care truly stood out.

I am not typically someone who leaves reviews, but Jeremy and Jorge absolutely deserve recognition. They are an incredible asset to David’s team.

Thank you, David, and Double J, for your outstanding service and for supporting homeowners across Santa Clarita Valley.
If you’re looking for an electrical company, you can trust, whether for residential or commercial needs, I HIGHLY recommend David Electric!

Thank you!

— Dr. Michael Llamas, Ph.D.

user_reviews.Description: No one likes to find out there is a leak on your property, and if you’re like me, you kind of don’t know what to do. Tim works with integrity!

user_reviews.Name: Kelly Lankford
user_reviews.Description: Extremely disappointed in George and his wife. Went into their store last week and the first thing I explained is that three different people's escrow is all riding on the date we need for installing new counters, so all parties could close escrow in our five day deal. I even agreed to pay more than the other contractors estimates so we could get a date confirmed. George confirmed a date. He then guaranteed the date after I stressed again how important it was that this was the most important thing for our timeline. My husband and I asked him to write it up so I could pay a deposit to confirm the date. George says "Oh, I will just email it to you." I said "we will wait. How long can it take?" He says "20 minutes." I told him "it's ok, we will wait." He starts stuttering/huffing and puffing about it making it seem that he doesn't want us to wait and he guarantees that we will get the contract within 20 minutes. We leave. 20 minutes go by..an hour goes by..then it's past 5 o'clock. We email him to ask him what happened. No response again. He then emails back the following day with an apology and the contract. Done. He tells me to come in to pick materials. I go in today to pick up materials and he tells me that he hoped I went somewhere else and went with another company because he can no longer do the date he confirmed. We already signed all of the escrow paperwork so did the sellers of the property we are purchasing and the buyers of our property. We are now starting our five days on the day that he confirmed and he tells me that he cannot start for another five days. Totally unacceptable behavior for a businessman. especially after I stressed how important this was .I asked him to please call the client and have them move out and he said no he doesn't want to make a client upset! I explained to him that what he did was unacceptable. He could've at least called me or emailed me. He said it didn't matter. Terrible businessman. Totally disregard of clients time. Unprofessional. Left us in a bad position now. Not only will I never work with him, but I will never refer anybody to his business and advise everybody to stay far away. Do yourself a favor and do not even attempt to do business with George. Check his other negative reviews as they speak for themselves. Terrible customer service.

user_reviews.Description:
Kitchen area was designed and custom built by owners Simon and George.

I recently had the pleasure of working with the incredible owners to custom build my kitchen, and I am absolutely thrilled with the results. From start to finish, the experience was nothing short of exceptional, and I can confidently give them a well-deserved 5-star review.

The craftsmanship exhibited by them is truly exquisite. Their attention to detail and meticulous approach to every aspect of the project left me in awe. The tiles were precisely cut and installed with absolute precision, resulting in a flawless finish that exceeded my expectations. The patterns and designs were flawlessly executed, creating a visually stunning and unique space.

Moreover, the professionalism and expertise was remarkable. They took the time to understand my vision and provided valuable insights and recommendations throughout the process. From selecting the perfect tiles to suggesting innovative design ideas, their expertise helped elevate the overall aesthetic of my kitchen. They were patient, attentive, and always ready to answer any questions or concerns I had along the way.

The level of service provided was truly outstanding. They were punctual, respectful, and worked diligently to ensure the project was completed within the agreed-upon timeframe. They maintained a clean and organized work area, minimizing any disruption to my daily routine. Their dedication to customer satisfaction was evident at every step, and they went above and beyond to ensure I was completely satisfied with the final results.

I cannot recommend this tile company highly enough. Their commitment to craftsmanship, exceptional service, and attention to detail are truly commendable. If you're looking for a tile company to custom build your kitchen, look no further. I am absolutely thrilled with the outcome, and every time I step into my kitchen, I'm reminded of the remarkable work they did. A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for making my dream space a reality!

user_reviews.Description:
Allen Air evaluated and upgraded our residential HVAC system in the spring (2019). I was happy with their work; however, the first time I needed the heating in the fall, I found it not functioning. The company would not back their work and failed to diagnose the problem. They suggested I might need new thermostats. I Googled and YouTube'd the problem on my own. It was simple to rule out the thermostats and pinpoint the problem to the zone control board. I bought and installed a new board and everything is fine now.
I have a strong suspension that they were taking advantage of a senior citizen.

user_reviews.Name: Louise Rausa
user_reviews.Description:
Carlos Espinosa is the face, brains, hands, and the aesthetic eye behind Shadai Construction. Together with his very competent workers, Shadai completely remodeled my entire apartment, literally from ceiling-to-floor. To make matters somewhat complex, I live in a high rise apartment building constructed in 1966, with concrete ceilings and floors between each story. In addition, all work was done during the COVID pandemic.

This job included the complete remodeling of a new kitchen and bathroom, all electrical, plumbing, custom carpentry, and new flooring throughout. It involved thoughtful design choices that went hand-in-hand with the construction work performed.

The remodel is beautiful and far exceeded all of my expectations! The kitchen functions better than any I've previously had and worked in. It has been the envy of all who visit. The compact bathroom, a sometimes necessary "down side" of "big city," apartment living... is attractive and comfortable, and optimizes use and storage.

To work with Carlos and his team has been a total pleasure. I cannot praise the high quality of his work, designs, work ethic, and execution of each highly enough. He listened carefully to my ideas and included me in every aspect of the process.

Louise Rausa, Los Feliz Towers, Los Angeles, CA

user_reviews.Name: Benai Boyd
user_reviews.Description:
I cannot say enough incredible things about iComfort Heating & Air Conditioning. The way they showed up for me—not just as a customer, but as a human being.

As someone living with an autoimmune disease, maintaining a strictly climate-controlled home isn’t a luxury—it’s a necessity. My body cannot regulate temperature, so going even a few days without AC is not just uncomfortable, it’s unsafe.

When an issue arose and I was told a needed part wouldn’t be available for several days, I was deeply concerned. I called and spoke with Vanessa, and from the moment she answered, everything shifted. She truly listened. She gave me the space to advocate for myself and met me with compassion, urgency, and care. I didn’t feel dismissed—I felt heard, respected, and supported.

Shortly after, Jose, the manager, personally called me back and immediately took action. He didn’t hesitate. He validated my situation and treated it with the seriousness it deserved. Within no time, he located the part and ensured that Javier was at my home first thing the next morning—before the heat could become dangerous.

And Javier—he was exceptional!!!!  So attentive, patient, and kind. He didn’t just fix the issue and leave—he stayed to make sure everything was working properly and that I was truly taken care of. That level of care meant more than I can express.

I also want to acknowledge the entire team that I encountered —Irene, Vanessa, Javier, and Manager Jose—each of them played a role in making me feel supported, safe, and valued. Their communication, compassion, and urgency were seamless and deeply appreciated.

That level of responsiveness, empathy, and integrity is rare.

To my disabled & chronically ill community: we have an ally in iComfort Heating & Air Conditioning. This is a company that doesn’t just provide a service—they show up with humanity, awareness, and real support.

If you’re looking for a company that will not only get the job done but will also treat you with dignity and care, please give them your business.

They are truly wonderful.

I can’t say enough good things about Peter and his crew. I would highly recommend Premium Legacy Roofing to anyone looking for quality work done the right way.

Before the big rains we had in March, Peter came by and had his crew go up on my roof and tarp the areas where the leaks were coming from. They put up three or four tarps to protect everything. What really stood out to me was that when my neighbors saw what they were doing, they actually chased his crew down the street and asked if they could come back and tarp their homes as well, and Peter took care of them without hesitation. That impressed me a lot.

When they came out to demo my roof, they made sure everything was cleaned up each day, which I really appreciated. At one point, a neighbor’s screen was damaged from wind blowing debris off the roof, and without hesitation, Peter offered to repair and replace it. That says a lot about the kind of integrity he runs his business with.

They were always on time, worked full days, stayed within the budget they originally quoted, and were completely upfront and honest throughout the entire process. They also took the time to walk me through everything that needed to be done and used quality materials. Knowing they are licensed, insured, and bonded gave me even more confidence.

They installed new paper under the existing tiles and redid the pattern, and the end result looks incredible. Honestly, it looks like a brand new roof. Several of my neighbors came over just to look at it, and many asked for Peter’s card because they were so impressed with the quality of the work.

I can’t say enough good things about Peter and his crew. I would highly recommend Premium Legacy Roofing to anyone looking for quality work done the right way.
user_reviews.reply_text_original: Bruce, thank you for the review highlighting Peter and the team's excellent service from start to finish. It’s gratifying to know our commitment to integrity and proactive problem-solving made such a positive impact, even extending to your neighbors. We appreciate your business. Take care!

user_reviews.Name: Elina Bell
user_reviews.Description:
We had an absolutely great experience with Premium Legacy R&C. They got recommended by word of mouth (already some bonus points there), and Peter, the owner, gave us the most thorough and detailed roof inspection we've seen compared to 5+ other companies. His estimate breakdown and material overview also impressed us, the price was right, and we committed to a full reroofing project. From the first day that the Premium Legacy team started working we knew that we chose right. Lots of communication along the way, prompt notifications about permits and inspections, and of course a very much appreciated tidying up at the end of each work day. The crew really, genuinely know their stuff.

We put the new roof to a test immediately after it was finished, with the crazy rain storms over December. 8+ inches of rain locally but zero sign of the previous issues we had experienced. Not only that, but Peter came out during the rain when we discovered a chimney problem, and quickly diagnosed the issue, tarped the chimney, then provided us with this additional repair. (The chimney crown needed to be replaced entirely, and they had a brand new one manufactured and installed within a few weeks.) The company can truly do it all, and do it WELL.

For an important project like this where quality work means peace of mind of several decades, it's important to choose correctly. Without a doubt Premium Legacy R&C delivered on their promise on professional, quality construction. We couldn't be happier with the end result.
