user_reviews.Name: Heather Kilpatrick
user_reviews.Description:
I have been recommending Mazza Inspections for over 7 years and Marc Mazza never fails to provide the most knowledgeable information and best service to my clients.  When I represent buyers on a home purchase and they ask for a recommendation, I never hesitate to offer Mazza Inspections as a top professional in the business.

Marc is amazing, he goes above and beyond for buyers.  He is more than just a "certified," home inspector, Marc is a Licensed General Contractor who provides buyers with a detail inspection and itemized report, as well as the information they need to make important decisions about their new home.  Marc offers advice about repairs without making a big deal about small things.  At the same time, Marc is there to protect the buyers and will not hesitate to explain, and show, them when a home has a repair that will require substantial money and time.

Mazza Inspections provides buyers with everything they need when inspecting a home: whole home inspections, sewer inspections, infrared thermography, fireplace/chimney inspections, and pool inspections.

Marc and Michelle Mazza are wonderful to work with, they provide excellent service with great follow-up and they are always available after the inspection is completed. Both my clients and I highly recommend them.

user_reviews.Name: Jacob Sexton
user_reviews.Description:
Marc is easily the best home inspector in the area. He is a true professional that can easily explain any situation about your house. Within the first five minutes of meeting Marc, I could tell how passionate and knowledgeable he was about his work. He not only is an expert at home inspections but someone you can fully trust. He truly approaches the task like he was buying the house for himself. Marc takes his time and is not the type of inspector that tries to get in and out quickly.

I had Marc come out and inspect a house in Santa Clarita. We talked on the phone beforehand, and it was obvious he knew his craft. In fact, he could name off facts about the house, the foundation, and potential fixes that needed to occur before even showing up. I have a history of renovating homes and doing construction work, but Marc was way ahead of me. Marc found things with the house that I would have never noticed. If you want to spend your money wisely then call Mazza Inspections.

After the house was inspected Marc sent me the report within no time. The report was super detailed and easy for anyone to understand. Everything wrong with the house was explained plus added detail to possible hazards/threats. I know people who go looking for inspectors that sugarcoat everything and tell you what you want to hear. Basically, those home inspectors are a waste of money. Marc is straight up with you and gives you a time limit to all the issues he finds.

Buying a house is stressful! Not knowing what is wrong with your house is more stressful. I am 100% sure Marc found every problem within the house. Now I am confident that I can take on these projects without the fear that there will always be something missing that I did not know about.

user_reviews.Name: Brian Martin
user_reviews.Description:
I am a first time home buyer and am trying to move through the home buying process as rapidly as possible, while trying to be as comprehensive as possible in doing my due diligence.  This is tough as somebody very unfamiliar with the home buying process, which is exactly why I value Mazza's approach so much.

My initial contact with Mazza was with Michelle over the phone in the evening on a Tuesday, as owing to my busy schedule I was unable to call them until late and needed to setup an inspection asap.  Before the evening was over, I had a full quote, and an appointment for that weekend, all of which was handled very professionally and with a personal touch in the communications.

Michelle and Marc arrived at the inspection with everything needed to perform an extremely comprehensive home inspection, which is something I especially appreciate as an engineer who is very detail-oriented.  For the duration of the inspection, I hung out with them and asked questions, was shown things to look out in my future home ownership, talked through options/given informal advice on some issues that came up, and overall really enjoyed the experience, which proved to be highly informative, very professional, but also easy what with their both being very down-to-earth and easy to hang out with, talk with, and joke with.

Marc and Michelle knew I was working to an accelerated schedule and prepared and sent the report to me less than 24 hrs after finishing the inspection.  The report was extremely detailed and has everything I need and more and I plan to use it as the basis for determining what work I need to do and in what order when I get the keys to my new home.  Additionally, they go out of their way to make themselves available for any follow-up questions/needs in the future.

I have been told that inspectors this comprehensive can be seen as too detailed.  When making this kind of investment, there should be no such thing as an inspector that is too detailed.  Mazza Inspections sets an exemplary standard for this kind of work and I rate them at the top of their game and would recommend them to anyone and everyone who needs a home inspection.

Lastly, they are not the cheapest option out there, but in my opinion you should not be looking for the cheapest option and even with a higher price tag, the return on investment is much higher with Mazza than it would have been with any other inspector out there.

Thanks Marc and Michelle, it was a pleasure

Take care,
Brian

user_reviews.Description:
Before you move into a property, many don't realize how important  it is to have a proper quality inspection.  What you purchase is solely your responsibility and being knowledgable upfront about what you plan to own can save you tens of thousands of dollars down the line.  There are several inspectors out there but I have yet to find anybody who has matched Marc's expertise, attention to detail, and overall care for the buyer.

Recently I made the decision to move on from a property after several issues came to light through Marc's on-site discussions and reporting. He takes his time through the inspection process and is open to answer any questions that might come up.

When the job is done, he quickly turns around a full, detailed report for you to review. His comprehensive and organized report is thoroughly outlined and easy to digest.  This gives you the chance to determine the most important question -- whether or not you want to take on those issues or move on and find a new property.

Quality inspections are essential to the home buying process and Marc does an incredible job informing you of everything you need to know before you make what might be the biggest purchase decision in your life.

user_reviews.Name: Jessica Cannistraci
user_reviews.Description:
Last summer, during a brutal 115° heatwave, my old air conditioner couldn’t keep up. I resorted to a makeshift cooling system using ice, a fan, and a styrofoam cooler. It definitely not something I wanted to repeat.

This year, I called Verona to take a look at my 30-year-old HVAC system, which had probably never been maintained.

Vahe, the technician who came out, immediately impressed me.

The first thing he asked was what my expectations were. That simple question put us on the same page from the start.

He then thoroughly inspected both the air conditioner and heater and walked me through the situation with honesty and clarity.

Given the system’s age and the phase-out of older refrigerants in California, Vahe explained that recharging it wasn’t a viable option. But what stood out to me most was that he didn’t try to push the most expensive solution—he worked within my budget and came up with three options that made sense for me.

When Vahe and his team came to install the new system (on a 95° day no less!), they were efficient, respectful, and organized. Despite the heat, they worked quickly and with great care. Vahe went the extra mile to make sure everything was set up properly and that I understood how to use it.

What really struck me was when, mid-install, my neighbor called asking for help with her own broken HV/AC system. Vahe made time to schedule her for the very next day. That kind of responsiveness and integrity is rare.

Now, I have a system that works beautifully it maintains a consistent temperature, and I can actually look forward to summer this year.

Thank you, Vahe and everyone at Verona, for making my home comfortable again. You’ve earned a customer for life.

I’ll add a couple pictures of my new system and the old system.

There’s a big difference between quality of product . The old system was purchased and installed by the home builder. It checked the box but wasn’t a quality system. It looks like it’s made out of tinfoil and fiberglass. You can also see where the old system was leaking

The new Lenox system was chosen by myself and a professional HV/AC installer Vahe, who corrected many of the errors from the builders.
